name: sell witnessed strategy products through the hive marketplace
asks: The ARCHMAGE-class product the Union can ship first is not account automation (custody-heavy, ToS-fraught) but the strategy products aagaard already prices: splinterlands-best-next-move and hive-engine-exit-tightness, delivered per-query over hive-x402 on propolis.hive.561.group. Differentiator no competitor has: every recommendation ships with its Lean proof hash and an RWIL witness trail, so the customer buys a certified claim, not a tip. Account automation for customers can follow later as a posting-authority delegation service (Hive-native, no key custody) once the strategy line has revenue and reputation.
